schema_source: Pydantic RuntimeRequest, RuntimeContext, ToolRequest, ToolResponse; export model_json_schema during backend implementation
authentication: Dedicated Langflow service identity over TLS; execution_ref is not a bearer credential. Bind persisted execution grant to service identity, owner, purpose, snapshot, tool scopes, expiry and absolute deadline.
routing: Langflow -> runtime gateway -> CallCraft -> internal domain tool; gateway is trusted transport, not an alternative AI tool executor

credential_policy.advance_llm_stt: Resolve user_ai_selections and encrypted user_ai_credentials through backend broker; verify owner/provider/capability/status
credential_policy.vip_llm_stt: Resolve VIP_* server settings through backend runtime configuration
credential_policy.embedding: Platform GEMINI_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY including Advance query embeddings
credential_policy.canvas_secrets: none; credentials:resolve is available only to trusted execution adapters, never ordinary flow output

server_requirements: Reauthorize every request; never trust client plan, payer or allowed_tools
Compile tool catalog schemas; validate arguments and successful result
Require stable idempotency key for mutations; same key and different payload is conflict
Service credential for CallCraft is separate from provider BYOK
Validate source ownership, consent, version and domain invariants
Return HTTP 200 only with valid context or tool outcome; use structured non-200 failures for transport/auth admission
Bound deadline and payload before upstream execution; record audit and trusted provider usage
Grant renewal for background attempt occurs only after snapshot and ownership checks
activation_gates: Implement backend endpoints and execution grant lifecycle
Verify CallCraft vendor binding and ephemeral credential delivery
Verify Langflow/LFX import and component build
Verify cancellation reaches vendor and mutation reconciliation
Complete per-tool and per-provider integration fixtures
